mechanisms.finding: Narrative uncertainty was explicitly hardened after a real false-positive: CLIP scores below 0.40 are linguistically hedged (likely/possibly/perhaps), preserving uncertainty for the downstream LLM instead of presenting weak similarity as fact.

The exact Kandinsky failure from the historical HONEST_REPORT is implemented as a code-level regression fix: art/AI detection runs before region captioning and low-confidence YOLO detections (<0.50) are dropped on art/AI scenes to prevent phantom objects from being fluently captioned.

Historical hard-set demographic misses drove an explicit CLIP face/person-crop age/gender layer with top1/top2 margin gating for age bins. This is useful lineage but must be treated as weak attribute inference, not sensor truth.

GoL-based visual dynamics and a 50-dimensional learned pattern-library readout are separate mechanisms. The library performs cosine-matched archetype-to-phrase stabilization; this is historical evidence for familiarity/dictionary readout, not proof of compositional understanding.

The module already exposes a structured representation with separate concepts, objects, OCR, faces, scene tags, captions, region captions, VQA, colors, places, fine objects, composition, GoL patterns and library matches. This is the strongest bridge to dissolved Retina: preserve/normalize these typed channels rather than throwing them away into description text.

critical_gap.finding: Although outputs are structurally separated by field, there is no single per-percept evidence contract carrying source-stage id, calibration/version, uncertainty/open-set state, contradiction status and truth-vs-prior semantics uniformly across all channels. The natural-language description still concatenates heterogeneous evidence into declarative text, so downstream consumers can lose the distinction unless they use analyze_structured().
critical_gap.current_implication: FRANK/Clay should make the structured evidence path canonical and treat description as a derived human/LLM convenience view.

lineage_reconciliation: HONEST_REPORT May-26 identified Kandinsky->bed->false-artist cascade as harmful Tier-3 behavior.
frank_eye.py May-27 contains an explicit pre-caption art/AI YOLO filter whose comment names the Kandinsky bed failure, proving a direct negative-result->code-fix lineage.

The code also adds demographics, richer vocabularies, region captioning and pattern-library readout, explaining why later strict/lenient coverage could improve without invalidating the earlier negative report.
